overview: This file traces Japanese tax policy under the Allied occupation from 1945 to 1949. It documents exemptions and disputes involving foreign nationals, efforts to improve tax collection, the reorganization of national tax administration, a detailed survey prepared for the Shoup Mission, and proposals addressing taxes that discouraged foreign investment.
interest: Directives, diplomatic claims, office directories, revenue tables, and reform proposals show occupation tax policy in practice.
